title: 卖掉年入百万的公司后，他陷入了"创业者诅咒"
title_en: After Selling His Million-Dollar Company, He Fell into Founder's Curse
title_jp: 年商百万ドルの会社売却後、「起業家の呪い」に陥った
title_ar: بعد بيع شركته بمليون دولار، وقع في لعنة المؤسس
carouselChartTitle: 卖掉年入百万的公司后，他陷入了"创业者诅咒"

{"ops": [{"insert": "卖掉年入百万的公司后，他陷入了"创业者诅咒""}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "第一次成功了，第二次却怎么也找不到产品市场契合", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "很多人以为，成功过一次的人，第二次会更容易。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Valentin Pichard告诉你：想多了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他大学刚毕业就做了个大数据公司，年入百万美元，最后卖了。然后呢？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "第二次创业，到现在还在苦苦寻找产品市场契合（PMF）。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2015年，Valentin还是学生。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "在法国创立了Homedata，做房地产大数据。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "团队12个人，年营收百万美元以上。2020年卖了，价格"几百万"。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "听起来很风光对吧？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但Valentin没赚多少。他是学生创业，股份被稀释得厉害。一轮13万美元融资，一轮50万美元融资，他的股份越来越少。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "卖出的钱，勉强够他启动下一家公司的。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "二、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他发现了什么？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "每次创业都是全新的，上次的成功经验，这次基本没用。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "新市场，新用户，新解决方案。一切从零开始。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "唯一能用的是什么？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "人脉。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这个不会丢。而且越早开始创业，人脉积累得越多。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Valentin说，他的人脉帮了大忙。技术专家、投资人、客户介绍，都是靠人脉搞定的。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "怎么建立人脉？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""别害羞，大胆去聊。哪怕对方看起来高不可攀。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他在论坛认识了一个3D界的大牛，因为讨论技术问题聊上了。又通过朋友认识了另一个正在卖公司的创业者。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这两个人后来都成了他的朋友，帮了他很多。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "秘诀是——主动谈论你在做的事，解释为什么它重要、很酷。让别人看到他们能帮到你。同时，真诚待人，有来有往。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在Valentin在做Naker。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一个3D内容创作工具，帮企业自动生成产品的3D图像、视频和互动体验。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "团队5个人，月入5000美元左右。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "	extbf{他坦承：还没找到PMF。}"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "什么是PMF？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Valentin的定义很直接："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""你不需要再营销了，产品自己就能增长。口碑、社区、大使，他们会帮你推。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Naker还没到这个阶段。虽然有强大的工具、优秀的团队、大客户在使用，但还不够。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "为什么第一次找到了，第二次这么难？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""Naker的市场很新，技术也很新。我们要花大量时间教育潜在客户，解释我们的方案能解决什么问题。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这是先行者的代价。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但他说，一旦市场起势，他们也会是第一个受益的。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "四、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Valentin还搞了个副业：FuryPage。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "用3D效果做落地页的工具。纯粹是兴趣，因为喜欢3D的各种可能性，觉得好玩。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他问：为什么要分心搞副业？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""我就是喜欢探索。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他之前还做过一个在线游戏Wazana，10000个订阅，但没变现，纯属玩着开心。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""我把自己看作连续创业者，用业余时间去创新。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "怎么平衡主业和副业？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "工作日全给Naker。晚上和周末，自由时间给FuryPage。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "两个Chrome窗口，两个邮箱地址。切来切去，互不干扰。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Airtable管一切。Naker的运营，几乎全部用Airtable管理。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "五、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Valentin的融资建议很有意思。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有句老话："要钱，得到建议。要建议，却会得到钱。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们找这三类人聊天："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "行业从业者", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "技术专家", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "做相邻业务的创业者", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "目标客户公司的人", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "建立关系，请教问题。等到融资时，再联系这些人。因为他们已经了解你的故事、进展和愿景，更容易被说服。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这招帮他们融到了65万美元。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写在最后"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Valentin的故事，给成功的创业者敲了个警钟——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不要觉得第一次成功，第二次就一定能复制。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "每次创业都是独特的挑战。你能带走的，只有人脉和经验。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "至于PMF？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "每次都从零开始找。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "正如Valentin说的——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "如果你不能让其他人认同你的愿景，跟着你干，你就永远找不到PMF。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这句话，值得所有创业者贴在墙上。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "原文来自Indie Hackers，由AI翻译并改写", "attributes": {"italic": true}}]}
content_en: After selling million dollar annual income company he fell intoentrepreneur curse. First time successful second time cannot find product market fit no matter what. Many people think someone who succeeded once second time will be easier. Valentin Pichard tells you think more. He just graduated from university made big data company million annual income sold it. Then what. Second startup until now still struggling to find product market fit PMF. One. Twenty fifteen Valentin was still student. In France founded Homedata doing real estate big data. Team of twelve people annual revenue over million dollars. Sold in twenty twenty price several million. Sounds glamorous right. But Valentin did not earn much. He was student entrepreneur shares diluted severely. One round one hundred thirty thousand dollars financing one round five hundred thousand dollars his shares getting less and less. Sale money barely enough to start next company. Two. What did he discover. Every startup is completely new previous success experience basically useless this time. New market new user new solution. Everything starts from zero. What can be used. Network. This will not be lost. And earlier you start entrepreneurship more network you build. Valentin says his network helped a lot. Technical experts investors customer introductions all done through network. How to build network. Do not be shy.
